figures.Vis-phenol-oh: The book's phenol equations with NaOH, Na and ethanoyl chloride and the phenoxide sketch; Original figure archived as c12-chem-ch22-fig-phenol-oh (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book says phenol and an acyl chloride produce 'an ether'; the product phenyl ethanoate is an ester. A warning callout gives the correction.
